scenes.basis: 10:1 "sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place" - no place is named; the journey inherits 9:52
10:25 "a certain lawyer stood up and tested him" - discourse on the road; the road to Jericho (10:30) belongs to the parable
10:38 "he entered into a certain village" - the village of Mary and Martha is not named in Luke
